title: InstaAd
description: A paid message from InstaAd. Your voice on the radio, instantly. No studio required.

lines.speaker: ad-announcer
lines.text: Got a business? <p:0.2> Get on the air today with InstaAd! <p:0.2> Just call one, eight hundred, five five five, snaz, wait for the beep, and record your message. <p:0.2> We blast it to thousands of listeners in minutes! <p:0.2> No studio, no editing, no problem. <p:0.2> InstaAd, your voice on the radio, instantly!
